description: This Java class 'ThingsNetworkProvider' implements the 'LoraProvider' interface to handle LoRaWAN messages from the Things Network (TTN). It provides methods to extract device identifiers, payloads, and normalized data properties from JSON messages received from TTN.

classes.name: ThingsNetworkProvider
classes.description: A LoRaWAN provider class for integrating with the Things Network, implementing methods to extract device info and data from JSON messages.

methods.name: pathPrefix
methods.description: Returns the URL path prefix for this provider, '/ttn'.

methods.name: extractDeviceId
methods.description: Extracts the device ID (hardware serial number) from the JSON message.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts the raw payload string from the JSON message.

methods.name: extractNormalizedData
methods.description: Extracts normalized data, specifically the function port number, from the JSON message into a map.
